subject: D-RUG tomorrow, May 18: building a website with RMarkdown and Github pages!

messages.author: b957975f29ba9e83
messages.subject: D-RUG tomorrow, May 18: building a website with RMarkdown and Github pages!
parts:
Hi all, 

Apologies for the late email this week! D-RUG will be happening tomorrow from 12 - 2 pm. We will start with a mini-workshop about building a website with Rmarkdown and Github pages. The second half of D-RUG will be open work time. As always, you can find us in person (360 Shields Library) or on zoom. 

Shout out to another R-related event this week -- Liza will run a workshop on network data and visualization in R also tomorrow,  May 18, from 10 - 12 pm. Here's the link to register. 

Hope to see you there!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

P.S. Check out our mini-workshop schedule for the quarter at the bottom of this email!

________________________________________________________________
Please remember to post your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website for more information.

Mini-workshop schedule: 
May 25: R in the browser (WebR package)
June 1: Spatial data in R
June 8: Converting text into data with regular expressions
